title: Engineering Manager
summary: An engineering manager leads a team of 5 to 12 software engineers, owning hiring, growth and delivery rather than writing most of the code. They sit between the team, product and business, and answer for both people and engineering outcomes.
dailyDuties: Hold one-on-ones, coach engineers and run performance reviews
Run sprint planning and track delivery
Agree scope, dates and the quarterly roadmap with product and business
Review designs for scale and risk
Track on-call health, postmortems and DORA delivery metrics

skills.expectation: Hire, coach and run reviews for a team of 5 to 12
Guide architecture and quality without writing all the code
Judge designs for scale and risk
Agree scope and dates with product and business
Shape a quarterly roadmap with product
Own delivery health: release frequency, change failure rate and recovery time (DORA)

certifications.why: Some service companies ask for it
